ev.q: This is the first report of transmission of Zika virus from an infected man to a sex partner through anal sex.
Patient A’s semen results were thus deemed equivocal.
Patient A’s specimen had Zika virus detected at 35 cycles with one primer set
The present case report indicates Zika virus can be transmitted through anal sex, as well as vaginal sex.
